signals.summary: Fourth layoff wave in a year; 400 jobs cut globally, part of a restructuring to cut operating expenses.
Workforce of 3,700 expected to shrink to 3,300 after the latest wave; down from 5,500.
Revenue fell 64% year over year in Q3 2024 amid weak US demand and European inventory surplus.
Safe harbor agreements with Sunrun for US-made inverters and batteries supporting domestic content tax credits.
